verdicts.note: HB 2085 [S8][S9] would split state government into two autonomous regions (Puget Sound and Columbia), each with its own governor, judges and legislature. It is a state-partition proposal framed as East-West representation and a lower-tax, lower-regulation eastern region [S9]. It is not about city, county or district authority, state mandates on local governments, zoning or GMA. Moving power away from Olympia points toward pole_a, but the mechanism is a new regional tier of government, and the rubric lists 'regional authorities' under pole_b. The axis fit and the direction are both inferential, so low confidence. There is no other local-control evidence in the dossier.

The direction toward universal coverage is clear: his website pledges to 'fight for universal healthcare coverage' [S3], and he said he would be interested in partnering with Whole Washington [S6]. But neither source states single-payer or public-only coverage, and the same website plank proposes 'incentives for employers to offer public or non-profit insurance plans', which works within the existing employer system. These are two campaign statements with no record behind them, so medium confidence rather than high.
